image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a car wheel mounted on a vehicle. The wheel features a complex multi-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (polished silver faces and black recessed areas). A black rubber tire surrounds the rim. The center cap displays a Mitsubishi logo. The wheel is resting on green grass, suggesting an outdoor setting. There is visible text overlay/watermark near the bottom of the tire.

The grass blades interacting with the tire contact patch appear slightly smudged and lack individual definition, showing minor fusion between the tire edge and the ground.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and confirm class alignment with high confidence.
To check for depth consistency between the spokes, the rim face, and the tire sidewall, ensuring no 'melting' of layers.
To audit the sharpness of the boundary between the rubber tire and the metal rim, checking for bleeding or fusion artifacts.
To analyze the legibility and structural integrity of the text artifact observed at the bottom.
To assess global coherence, lighting consistency, and any subtle texture anomalies in the metal reflections.

focus_areas: Integrity of spoke geometry and symmetry
Boundary sharpness between tire and rim
Legibility and structure of text watermark
Realism of metal reflections and highlights
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the symmetry of the alloy spokes; AI often fails to maintain perfect rotational symmetry in complex rim designs. Verify if the text artifact is a coherent watermark or gibberish. Check if the tire sidewall has any impossible bulging or texture smoothing.
